title: nb: confirm and user-authored add write review entries on interim and invalidated results
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

SPEC: an interim result "is not reviewed on its own", and reviews are for valid, non-interim results. It also says confirm writes a review on every result the node rests on.

`establish` (`bin/nb` lines 721-725) adds a review to every `derived-from` or `suggested-by` result with no interim or validity check. `nb nothing-yet` refuses both. Reproduced by two reviewers.

Decide which reading is intended, then make the two paths agree.
